description: This file contains utility functions and procedures related to managing local heavy check runtime operations, such as acquiring locks, applying policies for local checks, and handling environment variables and lock files. It appears to be a utility module used for controlling local heavy check workflows within a larger build or maintenance system.

methods.name: isLocalCheckEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the local check is enabled based on environment variables.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Determines if a specific flag or argument is present in the arguments list.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Modifies the environment variables and arguments to apply local tsgo (Go tool) policies.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Modifies the environment variables and arguments to apply local OxLint policies.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Synchronously acquires a lock for performing heavy local checks, handling lock file creation, timeout, and reclaiming stale locks.

methods.name: resolveGitCommonDir
methods.description: Resolves the Git common directory path for the given working directory.
